name: Gil Perez-Abraham
bio: Gilberto Emilio Perez-Abraham Jr. is an American actor, born in Baltimore, Maryland, and raised in Wichita, Kansas. Following graduation from the William Esper Studio in 2018, Gil was noticed and picked up for representation after having been seen acting in various Off and Off-Off Broadway plays.

credits.title: The Batman: Part II
credits.overview: Sequel to the 2022 film The Batman.

credits.title: Destroy All Girls
credits.overview: Alex bolts from her stifling home to ride with a band of inline street skaters. Bouncing around New York City with nothing other than skates and a camcorder, escape comes easy at first. But as family and identity collide, she's forced to face the one thing she can't outride – herself.

credits.title: Killing Castro
credits.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

credits.title: Atropia
credits.overview: When an aspiring actress in a military role-playing facility falls in love with a soldier cast as an insurgent, their unsimulated emotions threaten to derail the performance.

credits.title: Rocky's
credits.overview: After a shocking death, a group of old high school friends reconnect in the parking lot of a 24/7 deli to catch up ahead of the funeral.

credits.title: Carry-On
credits.overview: An airport security officer races to outsmart a mysterious traveler forcing him to let a dangerous item slip onto a Christmas Eve flight.

credits.title: Cosquillas
credits.overview: A dejected, depressed man riddled with anxiety is forced to take on an unlikely survival job to support his daughter and turn his life around.

credits.overview: According to Muslim practice, burial ought to occur within 24 hours of death — so after Manny’s immigrant husband, Sameer, passes away in an accident, he is confronted by a representative of Sameer’s family urging him to sign the paperwork needed to ship the body back to Kuwait. credits.title: Tripped Up
credits.overview: Aspiring chef Lizzy sets off with her three best friends in tow to compete in the prestigious Saucy Food Festival. What begins as a calculated career move quickly turns into a madcap misadventure full of food, fun and female bonding, where the girls learn that struggle can be the secret ingredient to success.

credits.title: Our Son
credits.overview: When his husband Gabriel files for divorce, Nicky fights for custody of their 8-year-old son Owen, as he struggles to come to terms with what it means to love someone and what it means to be a father.

credits.title: The Batman
credits.overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

credits.title: Killer Among Us
credits.overview: On the 4th of July, a serial killer has a moral crisis when he discovers that his latest victim is a high-school student; simultaneously, a rookie cop and a seasoned detective race against the clock to save her life.

credits.title: The Dark End of the Street
credits.overview: Residents of a suburban community enjoy a night at home with their friends and family, while an ominous threat looms just outside their doors.

credits.title: ANYA
credits.overview: A newlywed couple turns to a scientist for help having a baby and find themselves at the center of a genetic puzzle with far reaching implications and an ethically ambiguous solution.

credits.title: The Farewell
credits.overview: A headstrong Chinese-American woman returns to China when her beloved grandmother is given a terminal diagnosis. Billi struggles with her family's decision to keep grandma in the dark about her own illness as they all stage an impromptu wedding to see grandma one last time.
